summary: Frontend-only testing of the new mobile off-canvas sidebar drawer at viewport 390x844 and desktop non-regression at 1440x800. All 12 verifications passed (8 mobile, 4 desktop). Demo-login on mobile lands on /dashboard successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar.jsx uses h-screen on the aside while also setting md:h-screen — the mobile fixed drawer correctly uses inset-y-0 and h-screen which is fine; no functional issue.
AppShell mobile top bar is sticky with z-30 while drawer/backdrop use z-40/z-50 — correct stacking, drawer overlays the topbar when open.
test_credentials: Used demo-login-btn (no manual credentials needed). Backend demo creds in test_credentials.md if needed: amit@demo.team / Demo@2026.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile off-canvas drawer pattern is fully functional. Verified: (1) [data-testid='mobile-topbar'] visible at <768px and display:none at >=768px, (2) sidebar off-canvas by default with bbox.x=-260, data-mobile-open='false', (3) [data-testid='mobile-menu-btn'] opens drawer (bbox.x=0, backdrop appears), (4) [data-testid='nav-chats'] navigates to /chats AND auto-closes, (5) tapping [data-testid='sidebar-backdrop'] closes drawer, (6) [data-testid='sidebar-mobile-close'] closes drawer, (7) Escape key closes drawer. Desktop: topbar hidden (display:none), sidebar inline at width=240px (x=0), collapse toggle switches 240↔56px, nav to /projects works. No backend regressions tested (per request — backend was unchanged).
